_comment: 1.5k-CADENCE op: the THRESHOLD set that yields ~1500 ARTIFACT-CLEAN 2-visit alerts on a full-cadence night, WITHOUT a rank cut. Differs from op_2v_stream_fullcadence.json in ONE volume knob -- chi2_2v_max 30 -> 6 (user chose 1.5k over 1k for recall) -- plus HARD-DROPPING the confident-FP veto classes and a final morphology dipole veto. The count is whatever the thresholds yield (it is the point), not forced to N.
_dipole_veto: The morphology dipole veto is DMTN-007 style: flag a detection as a dipole if it is round-with-strong-peak-dipole (elong<1.6 & dipole>0.55) OR has a coherent adjacent NEGATIVE lobe in a small centred window (neg-lobe/pos-lobe flux>0.30 & neg-blob>=6px). The lobe measure catches ELONGATED dipoles (stretched +/- lobes) the roundness test misses -- validated 20260705 (dipoles with elong up to 3.0). Small window so a bright-star dipole in a stamp corner does NOT veto a real trail whose own centre is clean. Ref: dmtn-007.lsst.io.
_why_chi2: chi2 is the volume knob (it filters AFTER the orbit solve, so tightening it costs ~no runtime and the chi2<=5 set is a strict SUBSET of the chi2<=30 output -- filtering the existing stream is IDENTICAL to linking at chi2<=5). Measured on 20260705: chi2<=5 + veto-drop -> 1072 survivors; of those only 6 (0.6%) are morphology dipole RINGS -- a poorly-fit dipole chance-link has high chi2, so chi2<=5 removes rings for free, and the morphology veto mops up the last 0.6%. Generalises: chi2<=5 gives 1072/1345/838 on the three full-cadence nights 0705/0706/0710 (avg ~1085 ~ 1000), naturally fewer on sparse nights (0629 561, 0713 377).
_tradeoff: chi2<=5 is a 6x tightening from 30. The fullcadence op's own note says chi2 can be LOOSENED to ~10 to recover noisy real movers (orbit chi2 does not separate them). So chi2<=5 buys purity partly by shedding real faint movers with noisy orbits. chi2<=6 -> ~1545 (0705) if more recall wanted. score_min STAYS 0.70 (never raised -- the sub-5sigma floor is the detector's purpose; chi2 is geometry, not an SNR gate).
_drops: Confident-FP classes HARD-DROPPED (not flagged): stationary with BOTH endpoints counterpart, or n_counterparts>=3 (recurring static); static-line (staticVeto members); train (vetoTrain). KEPT+labelled: single-counterpart stationary (86% chance coincidence at 3in in a dense field -- dropping it sheds real slow movers). Then a morphology dipole veto (ADCNN.qa.alert_morphology: elong<1.6 & dipole>0.55) clears residual rings.
_note: 2-visit same-night purity is base-rate-limited (~0.17-0.56, ~8% at WFD); these thresholds remove IDENTIFIABLE artifact classes -- the residual is chance-link FP indistinguishable without a 3rd epoch. Real purity = a follow-up/3rd sighting.
_proximity: BRIGHT-STAR PROXIMITY veto: drop any alert with a member within 2.5in of a the_monster star brighter than mag 21. DEPTH IS THE POINT (measured 2026-08-06 on 0706 with an OFFSET NULL -- positions shifted 20-60in, which preserves footprint/density but decorrelates from stars, so the null rate IS the chance cost a real mover suffers): the residual dipole/RINGS in the delivered product sit on mag 19-21 stars, INVISIBLE to the old mag<19 refcat (surviving rings' nearest catalogued star was 26in away). mag<19/2.5in flags 21.7% of the product and 0% of the visible residual rings; mag<21/2.5in flags 55.8% including 42% of them, at an offset-null cost of 2.7% of real movers (vs 0.9%) -- ~20:1. The earlier '12% of real trails' figure was measured CIRCULARLY against ring-contaminated product alerts, not against a null. Needs the per-night refcat built with --mag-max 21 (build_refcats.sh).
_chi2_TRUTH: chi2_2v_max stays 7. A 2026-08-06 'measurement' briefly raised it to 30 on the claim that chi2<=9 discarded ~85% of real movers -- that was WRONG, produced by a bug in the injection harness (trail endpoints built by treating the IMAGE-frame `beta` as a SKY position angle, so every trail was rotated by its detector's orientation; trail-vs-trail PA agreed to ~2deg while trail-vs-motion disagreed by ~48deg, and the dpa_tm>20 hard gate then appeared to kill 81% of true pairs). With endpoints correctly pushed through each panel's WCS (as detect_night does) the shipped calibration is CONFIRMED SOUND: true-pair chi2 median 2.5 (the statistic is designed to be ~Ndof), hard gates kill only 5.8%, and chi2<=5 retains 74.7% / <=7 ~80% / <=9 86.6% / <=30 93.9% of true pairs. Truth harness: outputs/runs/pa_validate (inject_v2.py, endpoints fixed 2026-08-07).
_veto_TRUTH: Veto TP cost measured on the same unbiased injected movers: confident-FP 0.0%, bright-star proximity 2.3% (offset-null predicted 2.7% -- CONFIRMED), stationarity>=1 counterpart 0.0%. The veto stack is essentially free, so it -- not the thresholds -- is where purity comes from. NOTE a first pass measured 25.4% for proximity; that was an INJECTION PLACEMENT BIAS (movers seeded at existing detection positions, 45.5% of which sit on stars because detections are ring-contaminated). Real asteroids land within 2.5in of a mag<21 star only 1.8% of the time. Seed injections at RANDOM sky.
